SAP Communication Customer Communication For SAP Business Network Suppliers Real-Time Support for Procurement Webcasts TLS 1.3 Updates for SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network and SAP Fieldglass The SAP Product Engineering support team is excited to announce an important webcast that impacts all users – customers, partners, buyers, suppliers and PMOs. This presentation will provide insights on the suspension of support for weak TLS 1.2 cipher suites and the enablement of support for TLS 1.3 updates coming January 2025! The team will discuss how this impacts customers/partners, the actions required, as well as how to verify and test your TLS changes. Kindly join us for one of two English-language sessions that will contain the same content.
